routes.name: Tourist Visa on Arrival
routes.summary: Most travelers can get a tourist visa at Tribhuvan Airport and other entry points. Apply online first and bring the printed confirmation. Pay cash in USD.

other: Travel document holders are not eligible.
Listed nationalities must get a visa or ETA before travel.
Embassy pages for other countries say Indian citizens do not need a visa. Not confirmed on the pages read.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Ottawa, visa page
Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

stay.note: 15, 30 or 90 day options. Extendable up to 120 days, then 30 more, max 150 days per visa year (Jan to Dec), per the Muscat embassy page.

steps: Fill in the online application before you fly.
Pay the fee in cash USD at the airport.

routes.name: Tourist Visa from a Nepal Embassy
routes.summary: You can also get a multiple entry tourist visa at a Nepali embassy ahead of time. Fees are charged in local currency and vary by embassy.

other: Fees differ by embassy. Canada charges CAD 45, 70 or 180 for 15, 30 or 90 days. Oman charges OMR 12, 20 or 48.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Ottawa, visa page
Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

stay.note: Visa must be used within six months of issue.

routes.processing: Ottawa embassy says 4 business days. Muscat says same day.

routes.name: Tourist Visa Extension
routes.summary: A tourist visa can be extended up to 120 days at the Department of Immigration in Kathmandu or the Pokhara office. 30 more days may be granted, for 150 days max per visa year.

other: Late fees: US$2 per day for the first 30 days, US$3 for days 31 to 90, US$5 after that.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

routes.name: Gratis (Free) Visa
routes.summary: Some people get a free visa, including kids under 10 and Nepali-origin foreign passport holders.

other: Dependents up to age 16 of Nepali parents or a Nepali citizen parent, holding foreign passports.
Nepali-origin citizens until they leave after getting their first passport from a Nepal-based foreign mission.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

routes.name: Interim (Transit) Visa
routes.summary: A one day visa for travelers who must spend a night in Nepal before a trip to a third country, or whose plane made an emergency landing.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: For students, researchers and teachers, and their families. Needs a Ministry of Education recommendation and a bank balance certificate. Teachers also need a work permit.

other: Bank balance certificate required. Amount not stated on the page read.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

routes.name: Non-Tourist Visa (work and other)
routes.summary: For employees, development workers, journalists and spouses of Nepali citizens, among others. Needs a ministry or department recommendation. Employees also need a work permit.

other: Spouses of Nepali citizens can use this category.
Work permit needed for employees. Salary and other thresholds not confirmed.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

routes.name: Business Visa (investors)
routes.summary: For foreign investors, their authorized agents and export investors, and their families. Needs a ministry or department recommendation.

other: Investment threshold not stated on the page read.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

routes.name: Residential Visa
routes.summary: For notable international figures, Nepali-origin foreign passport holders, investors, and people settling without business activity.

investment.note: One time investment in the industrial sector

savings.note: Bank balance for non-business settlers, listed as about this amount

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page

stay.note: Duration not stated on the page read.

routes.name: Non-Resident Nepali (NRN) Visa
routes.summary: For people of Nepali origin who hold a foreign passport. Issued by Nepali missions or the Director General of Immigration, with Home Ministry approval.

other: Duration and fee not stated on the page read.

sources.label: Embassy of Nepal in Muscat, visa page
